stable_nflverse_player_id.notes: Use ID columns from the play/participation record; never infer a stable ID from fuzzy name matching.

completed_prior_game_pbp.notes: Only games completed before the matchup may update latent player state.

prior_snap_count.notes: Allowed only after source coverage and publication timing are audited; never use the current game's final snaps.

historical_depth_chart.notes: Must have a historical as-of/timestamp policy. A later corrected/final depth chart is unsafe.

historical_injury_designation.notes: v0.9B cannot use it until the designation is reconstructable at or before the historical T-120 forecast horizon.

current_game_realized_starter.notes: Do not use starter identity learned from postgame PBP to reconstruct a historical pregame forecast.

ngs_tracking_stat.notes: Use only a prior published period; current editorial NGS context is not automatically a challenger feature.
